items.title: pbakaus/impeccable
items.summary: impeccable 是一个面向 AI 编码助手的 UI/UX 设计技能，提供 24 个命令和 61 条确定性检测规则，解决 AI 生成前端设计同质化问题（如千篇一律的 Inter 字体、紫蓝渐变）。通过 /impeccable init 记录产品上下文后，可使用 polish、critique、audit 等命令进行设计迭代与质量检查，支持 CLI 和浏览器实时预览两种模式。
items.summary_en: Impeccable is a design guidance skill for AI coding agents that addresses repetitive SaaS template patterns by providing 24 commands, live browser iteration, and 61 deterministic detector rules. It starts from Anthropic's frontend-design foundation, installs via `npx impeccable install`, and initializes with `/impeccable init` to record durable product context in PRODUCT.md. The toolkit includes commands like `craft`, `audit`, `polish`, and `animate`, alongside LLM-only critique checks and a browser extension for deterministic rule execution without API keys.

items.title: OpenCode Model Router: per-agent model fallback chains with a local web UI
items.summary: OpenCode Model Router 是一个 OpenCode 插件（MIT 协议，当前 v0.3.1），为每个 agent 配置最多三级模型降级链，当主模型遭遇限流或断服时自动切换至备用模型，确保长会话连续性。插件通过本地 http://127.0.0.1:37337 提供 Web UI 管理界面，绑定仅 localhost，零外部依赖。安装方式为 `git clone https://github.com/sertdisk/OpenCode-Model-Router` 后执行 `tools/install-dev.ps1`。
items.summary_en: OpenCode Model Router is an MIT-licensed v0.3.1 plugin for OpenCode that adds per-agent three-slot model fallback chains (primary, secondary, tertiary), with provider included in each step's identity to defend against provider-level outages. Agents are managed through a dark-themed web UI at http://127.0.0.1:37337 (localhost-only) or a /model-router terminal command, and chains write natively to oh-my configuration arrays when applicable. The plugin has zero dependencies, supports variant-differentiated steps, and reads only from models already enabled in your OpenCode setup.

items.title: Vanam by Mahaveer Varma
items.summary_en: Vanam is an offline AI field guide built by Mahaveer Varma for the Hacktoberfest Open-Source AI Challenge that identifies birds and plants using on-device camera, microphone, and GPS sensors. The app runs a capture → identify → confidence-check → field-note generation → save-to-trail pipeline entirely on-device using local AI models, ensuring user data privacy without cloud uploads.

items.title: thedotmack/claude-mem
items.summary: claude-mem 是一个持久化记忆系统，支持 Claude Code、OpenClaw、Codex、Gemini、Copilot 等多个 AI 编程工具。用户可通过 `npx claude-mem install` 一键安装，系统自动捕获会话中的工具调用和决策信息，经 AI 压缩后在后续会话中注入相关上下文，提供 14 天免费试用。核心功能包括渐进式
items.summary_en: Claude-Mem is a persistent memory compression system that automatically captures, compresses, and reinjects context across sessions for Claude Code and other AI coding tools (OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Copilot, etc.). It installs via a single command (`npx claude-mem install`), offers a free 14-day trial observer, and supports multiple memory providers including Anthropic, OpenRouter, and Gemini keys. Key features include progressive disclosure with token cost visibility, skill-based search, and real-time awareness pushes to chat platforms like Telegram, Discord, and Slack.

items.title: Como funciona a memória de um agente de IA (e o que acontece quando ela esquece do jeito errado)
items.summary_en: AI agents don't inherently remember—each LLM call starts fresh, so an external memory system stores information and injects relevant context back into prompts. The author implemented and tested four memory policies on a simulated project over several months, using bge-m3 embeddings (1024-dimensional vectors) with cosine similarity searches; top-k retrieval returned scores of 0.6–0.66 for related content versus ~0.5 for unrelated phrases. Memory records include metadata fields like kind (episodic/semantic/procedural), source, and a trust score ranging from 1.0 (user) down to 0.3 (web).

items.title: TikTok rolls out an AI shopping assistant and one-click checkout
items.summary_en: TikTok is launching an AI shopping assistant that provides conversational, preference-aware product guidance alongside a one-click checkout feature directly from the For You feed, built in partnership with commerce platforms like Shopify, Stripe, and Salesforce. The move broadens its e-commerce strategy beyond TikTok Shop, aiming to keep users within the app rather than turning to external AI tools. TikTok Shop generated approximately $15.8 billion in U.S. sales in 2025, representing roughly 18% of all U.S. social commerce, while platform activity has contributed $81 billion to U.S. GDP and influenced 54 million Americans to make a purchase after viewing a TikTok video.

items.title: 卡兹克解读A16Z两份AI报告，AI使用广但付费和深度仍小众
items.summary: A16Z报告显示，美国近半数人口曾使用过AI，但深度渗透有限，仅25%每天使用，ChatGPT、Gemini和Claude的个人付费订阅率仅为4.5%，标普500企业中也仅有2%长期追踪AI价值指标。
